payload.body_you:
Your beliefs have to survive contact with your actual life. The philosophy that sounded wise in a book. The future you keep describing but never preparing for. The opinion you defend more strongly than you have studied it. Saturn moving through your 9th house makes borrowed certainty harder to live on.

Choose one subject worth learning properly. Finish the degree. Read beyond the summary. Organize the application. Revise the manuscript. Build the long-range plan in steps someone could actually follow. You do not need every answer before moving forward. You do need enough information to understand what the decision will require.
